# holds credential

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:holdsCredential`](gmeow-holdsCredential.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/holdsCredential>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an agent to a credential it holds. Non-functional — an agent may hold many credentials, and a single credential may be held by many agents (shared license, group certification).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Credential`](../classes/gmeow-Credential.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:holdsCredential`](gmeow-holdsCredential.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Credential`](../classes/gmeow-Credential.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to state that an agent holds a credential — a degree, certification, badge, or license — when the bare holding relation is what matters.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the issuing organization ([`gmeow:credentialIssuer`](gmeow-credentialIssuer.md)) or the certified subject matter ([`gmeow:credentialFor`](gmeow-credentialFor.md)), and avoid treating it as proof of validity — verification is a [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) over the credential ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

### How to use

- Assert the agent → credential triple; many-to-many is allowed (shared licenses, group certifications), and a signed [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) carries whether the holding is verified rather than this property asserting it.
